title: Decision-models hub: own fine-tune decision model, lead with align
description: Search ownership from docs/content-review-2026-10.md. 'align Jev to your data' is owned by /decision-models/ and is fine. 'fine-tune Jev' is owned by /blog/fine-tuning-jev/, but the hub's meta description opens with the article's first sentence ('You can't fine-tune Jev'), so both compete. 'fine-tune decision model' appears in no title or H2 anywhere. Changes in src/pages/decision-models.js: FAQ question becomes 'Can you fine-tune a decision model?' with Jev as the example; meta description leads with 'align'. Add the hub to the menu in gatsby-config.mjs or to the Research page header (Ryan's call on the menu). The six Jev articles now link to the hub (content PR 19).
